import colorsys
def lum(h):
    h=h.lstrip('#'); r,g,b=[int(h[i:i+2],16)/255 for i in (0,2,4)]
    f=lambda c: c/12.92 if c<=0.03928 else ((c+0.055)/1.055)**2.4
    return 0.2126*f(r)+0.7152*f(g)+0.0722*f(b)
def cr(a,b):
    la,lb=sorted([lum(a),lum(b)],reverse=True); return (la+0.05)/(lb+0.05)
def darken(h, target, bgs):
    h=h.lstrip('#'); r,g,b=[int(h[i:i+2],16)/255 for i in (0,2,4)]
    H,L,S=colorsys.rgb_to_hls(r,g,b)
    while L>0:
        c="#%02X%02X%02X"%tuple(round(x*255) for x in colorsys.hls_to_rgb(H,L,S))
        if min(cr(c,bg) for bg in bgs)>=target: return c
        L-=0.002
c=darken("#8B8A80",4.5,["#E2E0D8","#ECEAE3","#F7F6F2"]); print("rankC", c, [round(cr(c,b),2) for b in ["#E2E0D8","#ECEAE3","#F7F6F2"]])
b=darken("#4C6A6E",4.5,["#DDE3E3","#ECEAE3","#F7F6F2"]); print("rankB", b, [round(cr(b,x),2) for x in ["#DDE3E3","#ECEAE3","#F7F6F2"]])
print("accent on accentSoft", round(cr("#0E5E63","#D5E6E4"),2), "ink on soft", round(cr("#17201F","#E2E0D8"),2), "ink2 on soft", round(cr("#5B6664","#E2E0D8"),2), "reviewInk on soft", round(cr("#9A5A16","#E2E0D8"),2))
print("white on review", round(cr("#FFFFFF","#D9822B"),2), "ink on review", round(cr("#17201F","#D9822B"),2), "white on ink", round(cr("#FFFFFF","#17201F"),2), "accentInk on accent 72%?")
